Subject: POC wrap: metrics recap + quick quote/call request

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for running the two-week POC with us. Quick recap from our side and a small ask:

Key results (BrightCart configuration):
- Average inference latency down 38% (median from 250ms -> 155ms)
- Throughput improved ~2.1x at peak (concurrent sessions)
- Estimated inference unit cost down 23% vs baseline (projected monthly savings ~$8.5k)
- 98.4% success rate on production-style traffic (no model-timeouts observed)

I’ve attached the short results packet (brightcart_poc_results.pdf) and a one-sheet with the raw numbers (redwood_metrics_snapshot.xlsx).

Would BrightCart be open to:
1) A 1–2 line quote we can use in a results blurb (we drafted a suggested line below to make it easy), and
2) A 20-minute recorded call (audio-only is fine) with either you or Samir to capture a short soundbite and confirm attribution?

Suggested quote to copy/paste/edit if helpful:
"Working with Redwood reduced our inference latency and cost materially — the platform delivered faster responses and measurable savings that will scale with volume." — Alicia Gomez, Head of ML, BrightCart

If you’re OK with that, we can send a calendar invite. Availability from our side: Tue 11/3 between 10–12 PT or Wed 11/4 afternoon PT.

Thanks — no pressure, just want to make the case study process as easy as possible.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

Attachments: brightcart_poc_results.pdf (summary), redwood_metrics_snapshot.xlsx (raw numbers)
